checked_primary_sources: Microsoft official blog and Copilot product blog
Hugging Face official and community publications

accepted.reason: Microsoft connected generated apps, persistent agents, tenant runtime, identity, governance, inventory, and usage billing in one enterprise product change. Two dated Microsoft primary sources support the factual record.

rejected.candidate: GitHub enterprise managed settings in-product validator
rejected.reason: Useful enforcement feedback, but an incremental configuration aid that does not warrant a separate signal after Edition 02 covered the wider enterprise control plane.

rejected.candidate: GitHub Copilot usage metrics adds pull-request review stages
rejected.reason: Useful operational measurement, but limited to human review timing and not enough evidence of a broader AI engineering shift.

rejected.candidate: GitHub agentic autofix uses Copilot Memory
rejected.reason: A narrow integration between two public previews with no independent outcome, security, or reliability evidence.

rejected.candidate: Hugging Face community model and robotics posts
rejected.reason: Interesting community work, but the strongest performance and deployment claims were author-reported and insufficiently verified for this edition.

notes: Edition 03 treats Microsoft's release as a product-architecture change. The Signal Map movement is explicitly scoped to available enterprise infrastructure and does not claim broad adoption or production reliability.
